text:
rachel: Early heads-up  planning a config-only change targeting batching + timeouts for chat-v2. Canary 5% for 20m, no model binaries.

dan: What exactly are we changing? Which environments?

rachel: Adjustments: drop tenant_soft_limit 180 -> 140, increase per_request_timeout 3500ms -> 5000ms, bump max_batch_size 20 -> 28 and slightly extend batch_window_ms 10 -> 14 to better absorb peak short bursts. Applies to hosted + dedicated routing. Private stays unchanged.

vika: Please pin for dedicated to avoid mismatch: chat-v2@2026-05-03. Also add a quick failover: if error_rate > 1% for 3m route to chat-v2-fallback.

rachel: Adding pin and failover. I'll attach the config snippet to the canary bundle.

deploy-bot: Queued `/deploy-config --service=routing --change=batch-window-timeout --canary=0.05 --duration=20m --pin=model:chat-v2@2026-05-03`

rachel: Canary bundle snippet:
```yaml
routing:
  route: chat-v2
  model_pin: "chat-v2@2026-05-03"
limits:
  tenant_soft_limit_tokens: 140
  per_request_timeout_ms: 5000
batching:
  max_batch_size: 28
  batch_window_ms: 14
failover:
  on_error_pct: 1.0
  route_to: chat-v2-fallback
```

sre-bot: [staging-preflight] quick smoke: 300 reqs, errors=0, p50=140ms (baseline +40ms), p95=380ms, mem +6%

dan: Noting an overlapping maintenance in us-west in ~8m. Recommend excluding us-west from initial canary.

rachel: Excluding us-west and starting now.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 6732101130  traffic=5% (no us-west). Monitors: p95, error_rate, kv-cache-hit, mem. Auto-fail: error_rate > 1% for sliding 3m.

sre-bot: t+7m snapshot: errors=0.1%, p50=145ms, p95=390ms, token_cost_delta=-7.5%, mem +5.8%

rachel: Signal looks good. Planning ramp to 25% in 8m if no regressions.

deploy-bot: Ramping to 25% at 6732101165.

dan: us-west maintenance cleared; you can include it on next expansion.

rachel: Included and monitoring. Keeping on-call watch for 30m. I'll add this to the release notes and the digest if no issues.

deploy-bot: Thread closed at 6732101180  config active at 25% (will consider full roll in the release window if metrics remain green).
